# DEG HEATMAP
Recovered-group differential expression results were used to identify genes with the strongest longitudinal shifts between ED and 6-month timepoints. For each gene, average log2 fold change and absolute log2 fold change were computed across recovered contrasts. Genes with uncharacterized identifiers (prefixes ENSG or LINC) were excluded. The top 15 genes with the most negative average log2 fold change (ED-up) and the top 15 with the most positive average log2 fold change (M6-up) were selected, and their union (30 genes) was carried forward.

For these genes, log2 fold changes from the recovered-class contrasts were assembled into a Gene × APNS matrix and visualized as a horizontal heatmap, with genes on the x-axis (ED-up on the left, M6-up on the right) and APNS domains ordered from Pain at the top to Sleep at the bottom. Tiles are colored by log2 fold change using a centered purple–white–orange scale, with negative values indicating higher expression at ED and positive values indicating higher expression at M6. White tiles indicate domains where the gene did not pass filterByExpr and no logFC estimate was produced.

```{r}
DEG_all_APNS <- DEA_results_recovered %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.01) %>%
  distinct(Gene, APNS) %>%
  dplyr::count(Gene, name = "n_apns_sig") %>%
  filter(n_apns_sig == 10) %>%
  pull(Gene)

# top 15 genes upregulated at ED (remove uncharacterized genes/)
top15_ED <- DEA_results_recovered %>%
  filter(Gene %in% DEG_all_APNS) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_logFC = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_abs_logFC   = mean(Abs_logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    Domains_sig = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop" ) %>%
    # remove ENSG*, LINC*
    filter(!grepl("^(ENSG|LINC)", Gene)) %>%   
  arrange(Avg_logFC) %>%  # most negative first
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(Gene)

# top 15 genes upregulated at M6 (remove uncharacterized genes)
top15_M6 <- DEA_results_recovered %>%
  filter(Gene %in% DEG_all_APNS) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_logFC = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_abs_logFC   = mean(Abs_logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_WeightedScore   = mean(Weighted_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Domains_sig = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop" ) %>%
    # remove ENSG*, LINC*
    filter(!grepl("^(ENSG|LINC)", Gene)) %>%   
  arrange(desc(Avg_logFC)) %>%  # most positive first
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(Gene)


# ED-high first, then M6-high (reversed)
genes_top30 <- unique(c(top15_ED, rev(top15_M6)))


DEG_plot <- DEA_results_recovered %>%
  filter(Gene %in% genes_top30, APNS %in% APNS_ordered) %>%
  distinct(Gene, APNS, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(Gene, APNS,
    logFC = as.numeric(logFC),
    FDR = as.numeric(adj.P.Val)) %>%
  mutate(neglogFDR = if_else(!is.na(FDR) & FDR > 0, -log10(FDR), NA_real_),
    neglogFDR_cap = pmin(neglogFDR, 10))

DEG_hm <- expand_grid(
  Gene = factor(genes_top30, levels = genes_top30),
  APNS = factor(APNS_ordered, levels = rev(APNS_ordered))) %>%
  left_join(DEG_plot, by = c("Gene", "APNS")) %>%
  mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = genes_top30),
         APNS = factor(APNS, levels = rev(APNS_ordered), labels = rev(APNS_labels)))

lim <- max(abs(DEG_hm$logFC), na.rm = TRUE)

DEG_heatmap <- ggplot(DEG_hm, aes(x = Gene, y = APNS)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, fill = "white", color = "grey75", stroke = 0.25) +
  
  geom_point(aes(size = if_else(!is.na(FDR) & FDR <= 0.01, neglogFDR_cap, NA_real_),
                 fill = if_else(!is.na(FDR) & FDR <= 0.01, logFC, NA_real_)),
                 shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) +
scale_size_area(name = "-log10(FDR)", max_size = 5,
                limits = c(2, 10),
                breaks = c(2, 6, 10), 
                labels = c("2", "6", ">10"),
                guide = "none") +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
  name = "expression\nlog2FC\n(ED → 6M)",
  low = "#006A98",     # higher at ED
  mid = "white",
  high = "#67B6B2",    # higher at 6M
  midpoint = 0,
  limits = c(-lim, lim),
  na.value = "white",
  breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
  labels = c("-1", "0", "1")
) +
  
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top",
                               title.hjust = 0.5,
                               barheight = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                               barwidth = unit(0.5, "cm"),
                               title.theme = element_text(
                                 size = 7,
                                 margin = margin(b = 8)))) +

  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL, title = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_line(size = 0.5),
    axis.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
                                   size = 6, color = "black",face = "italic", margin = margin(b=0)),
    axis.ticks.x.top = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 7), 
  
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.75)) +

  scale_x_discrete(limits = genes_top30, position = "top",
                   expand = expansion(mult = c(.03, .03))) +

  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(.07, .07)), 
                   labels = setNames(APNS_ordered, APNS_ordered))

ggsave(DEG_heatmap, filename = "Differential Expression Analyses/Plots/DEG Heatmap Recovered.jpg", width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```


# VOLCANOE PLOTS
Volcano plots were generated for each APNS domain and latent class to visualize differential expression patterns. For each subset, log2 fold-change was plotted against –log10(FDR-adjusted p-value), with a dashed horizontal line indicating the FDR < 0.01 threshold. Points were colored according to latent class, with genes below the significance threshold shown in gray. The number of significant DEGs (FDR < 0.01) was computed per plot and added as the panel title. Latent classes identified as “Recovered” or “Chronic” for each domain were visually highlighted by adding a cyan or firebrick border, respectively. This framework enables direct comparison of transcriptional activity across latent classes within each APNS domain.

## Function
```{r}
create_volcano_plot <- function(data, category_name, class_name,
                                x_limits = c(-1.4, 1.4),
                                pval_threshold = 0.01,
                                deg_pval_cutoff = 0.01) {

  # count DEGs
  num_degs <- sum(data$adj.P.Val < deg_pval_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
  title <- paste(num_degs, "DEGs")

  ggplot(data, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val))) +
    
  geom_point(aes(color = ifelse(adj.P.Val < pval_threshold, Class, 
  "Below Threshold")), size = 0.5, stroke = 0.5, shape = 19,  alpha = 0.5) +
    
    # add FDR threshold line
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pval_threshold),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    
    # axis and scale
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits, breaks = c(-1, 0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
    
    
    # colors
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Low" = "#AAA8B3", 
                                  "Moderate Recovery" = "#858290", 
                                  "Moderate" = "#514D5B", 
                                  "High" = "#0B090D", 
                 "Below Threshold" = "#D7D9DF")) +

    # theme
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 5,color = "transparent",
                                hjust = 0.5,margin = margin(b = 0)),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", hjust = 1.15),
       axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black",vjust = 2),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.75, fill = NA), 
      legend.position = "none", 
      axis.ticks.length.y = unit(0, "pt"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 1, r = 2, b = 1, l = 2, unit = "pt"))
}


all_plots <- list()

for (apns_name in APNS_ordered) {
  for (class_name in class_order) {
    class_data <- all_DEA_results %>%
      filter(APNS == apns_name, Class == class_name)
    
    if (nrow(class_data) > 0) {
      plot <- create_volcano_plot(class_data, apns_name, class_name)
      all_plots[[paste(apns_name, class_name, sep = "_")]] <- plot
    }
  }
}

# store bordered plots here
bordered_plots <- list()

for (apns in APNS_ordered) {

  # resolved group for this APNS
  recovered_class <- recovered_class_for(apns)
  recovered_key <- paste0(apns, "_", recovered_class)

  if (recovered_key %in% names(all_plots)) {
    bordered_plots[[paste0(recovered_key, "_border")]] <-
      all_plots[[recovered_key]] +
      theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "#2A93B5", size = 2, fill = NA), 
             plot.title = element_text(size = 6, color = "black", hjust = 0.5,
                                       margin = margin(b = 1)))
  }

  # chronic group for this APNS
  chronic_class <- chronic_class_for(apns)
  chronic_key <- paste0(apns, "_", chronic_class)

  if (chronic_key %in% names(all_plots)) {
    bordered_plots[[paste0(chronic_key, "_border")]] <-
      all_plots[[chronic_key]] +
      theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "#8D1946", size = 2, fill = NA), 
            plot.title = element_text(size = 6, color = "black", hjust = 0.5,
                                       margin = margin(b = 1)))
  }
}
```


## Apply
Individual volcano plots were mapped back to their corresponding APNS domains and latent classes to enable downstream assembly of domain-specific figure panels. For each APNS outcome, the four latent-class plots (Low, Moderate Recovery, Moderate, High) were retrieved from the full plot list, and the bordered versions corresponding to the recovered and chronic classes were paired alongside them. This created a structured set of plot objects for each domain, preserving both the unmodified volcano plots and the border-annotated versions marking recovery (cyan3) and chronicity (firebrick4).

## Add trajectories to volcanoes 
Trajectory–volcano panel assembly: Latent-class trajectory plots and volcano plots were combined into a unified 10×5 grid (one row per APNS domain). For each APNS, a list was constructed containing the domain’s trajectory plot followed by the four class-specific volcano plots (Low, Moderate Recovery, Moderate, High), with recovered and chronic classes marked by cyan and firebrick borders, respectively. Helper functions computed the maximum −log10(FDR) within each APNS row and applied a shared y-axis range and breaks across that row’s volcano plots to standardize vertical scaling. The resulting trajectory plus aligned volcano plots were concatenated row-wise in APNS order and arranged into a 5-column × 10-row layout, then exported as a high-resolution figure for downstream illustration.
```{r}

# vertical 
apns_outcomes_traj_vol <- list(
  Pain = list(line_pain, pain_low, pain_modrec_bord, pain_mod, pain_high_bord),
  Avoidance = list(line_avoidance, avoidance_low, avoidance_modrec_bord, avoidance_mod, avoidance_high_bord),
  Reexperience = list(line_reexperience, reexperience_low_bord, 
                      reexperience_modrec, reexperience_mod, reexperience_high_bord),
  Hyperarousal = list(line_hyperarousal, hyperarousal_low_bord, 
                      hyperarousal_modrec, hyperarousal_mod, hyperarousal_high_bord),
  Anxious = list(line_anxious, anxious_low_bord, anxious_modrec, anxious_mod, anxious_high_bord),
  Dpression = list(line_depression, depression_low_bord, depression_modrec, depression_mod, depression_high_bord),
  Somatic = list(line_somatic, somatic_low_bord, somatic_modrec, somatic_mod, somatic_high_bord),
  MentalFatigue = list(line_mentalfatigue, mentalfatigue_low_bord, 
                       mentalfatigue_modrec, mentalfatigue_mod, mentalfatigue_high_bord),
  Nightmare = list(line_nightmare, nightmare_low_bord, nightmare_modrec, nightmare_mod, nightmare_high_bord),
  Sleep = list(line_sleep, sleep_low_bord, sleep_modrec, sleep_mod, sleep_high_bord))

#apns_outcomes_traj_vol <- apns_outcomes_traj_vol[APNS_ordered]



# helpers for volcano y alignment (per APNS row) 
get_max_volcano_y <- function(vol_list) {
  max(sapply(vol_list, function(p) {
    if (!is.null(p$data) && "adj.P.Val" %in% names(p$data)) {
      max(-log10(p$data$adj.P.Val), na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  }), na.rm = TRUE)
}

align_volcano_y <- function(vol_list) {
  
  max_y <- get_max_volcano_y(vol_list)
  max_y <- max_y + 0.75
  
  if (!is.finite(max_y)) max_y <- 2

  upper <- ceiling(max_y)
  if (upper %% 2L != 0L) upper <- upper + 1L

  breaks <- c(0, round(upper / 2), upper)

  y_labels <- function(x) {
      parse(text = ifelse(
        x < 10,
        paste0("phantom(0)*", x),
        as.character(x)
      ))
    }

  lapply(vol_list, function(p) {
    if (!is.null(p$data) && "adj.P.Val" %in% names(p$data)) {
      
      p + scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, upper),
        breaks = breaks,
        labels = y_labels
      )
      
    } else {
      p
    }
  })
}


# align volcanoes within each APNS row and flatten to 10×5 grid 
rows_aligned <- lapply(apns_outcomes_traj_vol, function(plist) {
  traj <- plist[[1]]
  vols <- plist[2:5]
  vols_aligned <- align_volcano_y(vols)
  c(list(traj), vols_aligned)
})

# flatten row-by-row
combined_plots <- unlist(rows_aligned, recursive = FALSE)

# tighten margins a bit
combined_plots <- lapply(
  combined_plots,
  function(p) p + theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 2, b = 0, l = 2),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text( margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(margin = margin(t = 3))
  )
)



plot <- ggarrange(
  plotlist = combined_plots,
  ncol = 5,
  nrow = 10,
  align = "hv",
  widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1) 
) 


```


## Figure 1
```{r}
blank_plot <- ggplot() + theme_void()
combined_plots2 <- lapply(combined_plots, function(p) if (is.null(p)) blank_plot else p)



row_grobs <- lapply(seq_len(10), function(i) {
  
  idx <- ((i - 1) * 5 + 1):((i - 1) * 5 + 5)

  row_plot <- ggarrange(
    plotlist = combined_plots2[idx],
    ncol = 5,
    nrow = 1,
    align = "hv",
    widths = c(1.15, 1, 1, 1, 1)
  ) +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t = 3, r = 1, b = 0, l = 0)
    )

  
ggdraw(row_plot) +
  draw_label(
    paste0(letters[i], ""),
    x = 0,
    y = 1.07,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1.55,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 9
  ) +
  draw_label(
    APNS_labels[i],
    x = 0.03,   
    y = 1.025,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1.55,
    size = 7
  )
})


plot <- ggarrange(plotlist = row_grobs, ncol = 1, nrow = 10, align = "hv",  heights = rep(1, 10))

ggsave(plot, filename= "Differential Expression Analyses/Plots/APNS Volcano Plot.jpg", width = 88, height = 160, units = "mm", dpi = 600)

```
